title: Musher Component Document
description: A reusable, versioned definition of one workload — its source, runtime shape, health probes, and configuration contract.
$comment: Structural and type validation only — cross-document reference resolution, slug/directory agreement, and platform capability checks are separate validation layers. See spec.md.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Must be COMPONENT.

specVersion.description: Version of the Musher specification this document is written against.

arguments.description: Build arguments keyed by argument name, injected into the image build context (Docker ARG). Build-time configuration only — runtime configuration rides on the workload's envVars.

builderImage.description: Buildpacks builder image, or null when not building with buildpacks.

dockerfilePath.description: Path to the Dockerfile relative to the repo root, or null when not using a Dockerfile.

strategy.description: How the git source becomes an image: DOCKERFILE or BUILDPACKS.

configKey.description: Key of the organization's saved configuration value, resolved server-side at snapshot compute. The component never holds plaintext; the entry's own key may alias it.

type.description: Discriminator marking an identity-only configuration reference.

inputs.description: Typed input declarations keyed by input name.

outputs.description: Typed output declarations keyed by output name.

containerPort.description: Port the workload listens on inside the container.

protocol.description: Protocol served on the port: HTTP, HTTPS, WS, GRPC, TCP, or UDP.

visibility.description: Reachability: PUBLIC for an externally reachable URL, or PRIVATE for internal-mesh only.

key.description: Name of the environment variable. Uppercase letters, digits, and underscores; must not start with a digit (e.g. DATABASE_URL). Unique within envVars.

value.description: How the value resolves, discriminated on type: LITERAL (verbatim value) or CONFIG_REF (resolved at snapshot compute).

name.description: The branch name or commit SHA to build from.

type.description: Which git ref is pinned: BRANCH or COMMIT.

build.description: How the repository is built into an image, or null when defaults apply.

ref.description: Branch or commit to build from, or null when unpinned.

repositoryUrl.description: Git repository URL the platform builds into an image.

ComponentHealthProbes.description: Staged health probes: startup, readiness, liveness.

liveness.description: Aliveness gate; failure restarts the container. Optional.

readiness.description: Traffic gate; failure pulls the replica from routing without a restart. Required for a SERVICE exposing a public endpoint.

startup.description: Initialization gate; failure means not-yet-started. Optional.

ref.description: OCI image reference the workload runs from.

type.description: Discriminator marking a pre-built OCI image source.

description.description: Human-readable description of the input, or null when none is set.

generator.description: Auto-generation spec when the platform mints the value at deploy time, or null when the value is supplied or wired.

isRequired.description: True when the input must be satisfied before the component can be deployed.

platformDefault.description: Platform-derived default bound into the target env var — PUBLIC_HOSTNAME injects the component's own public endpoint hostname, PUBLIC_URL the full https URL of that endpoint; null when the value is user-supplied, wired, or generated.

schema.description: Data contract of the value: type, format, pattern, enum, default, sensitivity.

suppliedBy.description: Who satisfies the input: CONNECTION (wired from an upstream component's output) or USER (supplied by the deploying user via the install form).

target.description: Where the resolved value is bound, or null when the consumer injects it manually.

ui.description: Presentation metadata for the install form. Required when suppliedBy is USER; must be null when suppliedBy is CONNECTION.

envVarKey.description: Environment variable the resolved value is bound into at runtime materialisation (e.g. ADMIN_EMAIL). Uppercase letters, digits, and underscores; must not start with a digit.

ComponentInputUi.description:
Presentation metadata for a USER-supplied input.

The install-form control is derived from the input's schema (enum →
select, BOOLEAN → toggle, EMAIL format → email field, sensitive →
masked field) — only the label needs declaring.

label.description: Human-readable label shown on the install form.

isSensitive.description: True when the value is secret material — masked in read surfaces and never echoed back.

type.description: Discriminator marking a verbatim literal value.

value.description: Verbatim value injected into the workload. Empty string is allowed.

ComponentMetadata.description: Identity block of a component document — the name is the file stem.

version.description: Lineage version of this component. Required (never defaulted) so the component's content is a pure function of this file, and it is the version the item's blueprint nodes pin.

description.description: Human-readable description of the output, or null when none is set.

schema.description: Data contract of the published value: type, format, sensitivity.

value.description: Static value for DECLARED outputs, or null for DERIVED outputs resolved at runtime.

valueFrom.description: DERIVED outputs carry value=null and are platform-populated; DECLARED outputs carry a static value.

endpoint.description: Name of the endpoint whose port the probe targets. Null selects the primary endpoint.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures required to consider the probe failing.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after start before the first probe.

path.description: HTTP path the platform polls for this probe.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes required to consider the probe passing.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a probe response.

cron.description: Cron expression on which a CRON workload runs.

contract.description: The composition contract: typed inputs the component needs and outputs it publishes.

workload.description: How the component runs: source, runtime shape, endpoints, and configuration.

byteLength.description: Number of random bytes generated for the value.

charset.description: Explicit character set for the generated value, or null when the encoding default is used.

encoding.description: Encoding applied to the random bytes: HEX, BASE64, BASE64URL, or ALPHANUMERIC.

ComponentValueSchema.description: Data contract of an input or output value (JSON-Schema subset).

default.description: Pre-filled value when none is supplied, or null when the value must be provided.

enum.description: Allowed values when the value is a closed enumeration; empty when unconstrained.

format.description: Semantic refinement of a STRING value: EMAIL, URI, ENDPOINT_URL, or CONNECTION_STRING; null when unrefined.

isSensitive.description: True when the value is secret material: handled as a secret reference, masked in UIs, never echoed back.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match, or null when unconstrained.

semanticType.description: Backing-service compatibility tag the Blueprint publish gate matches when wiring this value into a consumer input; null when the value is not specific to a backing service.

type.description: Primitive shape of the value: STRING, INTEGER, or BOOLEAN.

accessMode.description: How the materialized volume is shared across replicas: READ_WRITE_ONCE (attached block volume, mounts on a single replica) or READ_WRITE_MANY (shared network volume, mounts on every replica).

isReadOnly.description: True when the volume is mounted read-only.

mountPath.description: Absolute path where the volume is mounted in the workload.

sizeGib.description: Default provisioned size of the volume in gibibytes.

command.description: Command run for JOB and CRON workloads, or null otherwise.

endpoints.description: Endpoints the workload exposes, keyed by endpoint name.

envVars.description: Environment variables injected into the running workload. Each entry pairs a key (e.g. DATABASE_URL) with a value discriminated on type: LITERAL (verbatim value) or CONFIG_REF (resolved at snapshot compute). Keys are unique. Build-time values belong in source.build.arguments instead.

health.description: Staged health probes (startup, readiness, liveness), or null when none are defined.

kind.description: Runtime shape: SERVICE (long-running, may expose endpoints), WORKER (long-running, no endpoints), JOB (one-shot command), or CRON (scheduled command).

schedule.description: Cron schedule for CRON workloads, or null otherwise.

source.description: Discriminated image or git source the workload is built or run from.

volumes.description: Default volumes provisioned for deployments, keyed by volume name.
